title: Longest Chunked Palindrome Decomposition
key_insight: 贪心地从两端找最短的相同前缀和后缀
approach: 双指针从两端向中间扫描，尽早匹配相同子串以最大化分块数
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def longestDecomposition(self, text: str) -> int:
        n = len(text)
        res = 0
        l, r = 0, n - 1
        left, right = "", ""
        while l < r:
            left += text[l]
            right = text[r] + right
            if left == right:
                res += 2
                left = right = ""
            l += 1
            r -= 1
        if l == r or left:
            res += 1
        return res

title: Swap For Longest Repeated Character Substring
key_insight: 对每种字符找最长连续段，考虑合并中间只隔一个不同字符的两段
approach: 按字符分组，检查相邻同字符组能否通过一次swap合并
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def maxRepOpt1(self, text: str) -> int:
        from collections import Counter
        count = Counter(text)
        # Group consecutive same chars
        groups = []
        i = 0
        while i < len(text):
            j = i
            while j < len(text) and text[j] == text[i]:
                j += 1
            groups.append((text[i], j - i))
            i = j
        res = 0
        for i, (c, l) in enumerate(groups):
            # Single group + possibly one swap from elsewhere
            res = max(res, min(l + 1, count[c]))
            # Merge two groups separated by one different char
            if i >= 2 and groups[i-2][0] == c and groups[i-1][1] == 1:
                merged = l + groups[i-2][1]
                res = max(res, min(merged + 1, count[c]))
        return res

title: Minimum Cost to Connect Sticks
key_insight: 每次合并最小的两根棍子，类似哈夫曼编码

code_python3:
import heapq
class Solution:
    def connectSticks(self, sticks: list[int]) -> int:
        heapq.heapify(sticks)
        cost = 0
        while len(sticks) > 1:
            a = heapq.heappop(sticks)
            b = heapq.heappop(sticks)
            cost += a + b
            heapq.heappush(sticks, a + b)
        return cost

title: Remove Zero Sum Consecutive Nodes from Linked List
key_insight: 用前缀和+哈希表记录前缀和对应的节点，相同前缀和之间的段和为0需删除
approach: 计算前缀和，若出现相同前缀和则删除中间节点
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def removeZeroSumSublists(self, head):
        dummy = ListNode(0)
        dummy.next = head
        prefix_sum = 0
        seen = {0: dummy}
        node = head
        while node:
            prefix_sum += node.val
            seen[prefix_sum] = node
            node = node.next
        prefix_sum = 0
        node = dummy
        while node:
            prefix_sum += node.val
            node.next = seen[prefix_sum].next
            node = node.next
        return dummy.next

key_insight: 固定窗口大小k，统计窗口和超过upper加1分，低于lower减1分
approach: 滑动窗口维护k天的卡路里总和，与上下限比较
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def dietPlanPerformance(self, calories: list[int], k: int, lower: int, upper: int) -> int:
        window_sum = sum(calories[:k])
        points = 0
        if window_sum < lower: points -= 1
        elif window_sum > upper: points += 1
        for i in range(k, len(calories)):
            window_sum += calories[i] - calories[i-k]
            if window_sum < lower: points -= 1
            elif window_sum > upper: points += 1
        return points

class Solution:
    def dayOfTheWeek(self, day: int, month: int, year: int) -> str:
        days = ['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday']

        d = datetime.date(year, month, day)
        return days[d.isoweekday() % 7]

title: Maximum Subarray Sum with One Deletion
key_insight: 维护两个状态：不删除元素的最大子数组和、删除一个元素的最大子数组和
approach: dp0[i]不删除时以i结尾的最大和，dp1[i]删除一个时以i结尾的最大和
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def maximumSum(self, arr: list[int]) -> int:
        n = len(arr)
        # no_del: max subarray ending here with no deletion
        # one_del: max subarray ending here with one deletion
        no_del = arr[0]
        one_del = float('-inf')
        res = arr[0]
        for i in range(1, n):
            one_del = max(one_del + arr[i], no_del)  # delete arr[i] or delete previous
            no_del = max(no_del + arr[i], arr[i])
            res = max(res, no_del, one_del)
        return res
